CHRISTMAS UPDATE IS HERE 🎅! NEW CODE AT 120,000 LIKES

Step into the world of intense football/soccer action inspired by the iconic animes "Inazuma Eleven"! and "Blue Lock"! Unleash your creativity as you build and manage your dream team, harnessing unique skills and powerful techniques to dominate the pitch. Choose your role: be a collaborative teammate or a flashy solo star—the choice is yours!

Compete in thrilling matches, earn experience, and rise through the ranks of the ultimate football league. Join forces with friends or take on rivals to carve your name into football history!
